status: Provisional theoretical scheduled capacity using user-specified train assumptions; not observed ridership or available boarding capacity.
service_day_definition: GTFS service date selected at the Roosevelt Island stop; after-midnight service is included under its originating service date. Not a midnight-to-midnight count.
unit: passenger places per service day per segment and direction
limitations: Each direction has 115 M trips and 37 F trips in the source profile. Car model, train length and passenger places are user-specified assumptions, not verified historical train assignments.

Every scheduled trip is assumed to operate at its stated passenger capacity. Values are theoretical vehicle-place totals, not passenger counts, demand, guaranteed operational throughput or space available to board at Roosevelt Island.

Northbound trains traverse both the Manhattan-to-island and island-to-Queens segments; southbound trains traverse both the Queens-to-island and island-to-Manhattan segments. Segment figures overlap and must not be added as independent island passenger trips.
M and F assumptions were applied by route ID to every selected weekday service-day trip, including after-midnight trips; no additional time-of-day cutoff was imposed.
Capacity, service changes, station access and passenger crowding constraints have not been independently verified.
